stages.representation: libNVVM LTOIR linked with all 168 reducing-load kernels retained
stages.detail: CUDA 13.3 nvJitLink cubin SHA-256: sm_103a 8fd928ee51753a88c87fa9b09fc73935a4fd1aab0d950974b2414db6827b7026; sm_110a 9befc21d779f0d52dc78d9a0970dcf8f2f395b8ddc56f8d6066fbdbc3a6fa96f; separately proven family targets sm_103f fb80ed53fa56b7040b71f921bd74ad3d8930da3589bf317426fc70e0fa49878b; sm_110f 4714a81db82b1a177d3a3aee3ed35f4275f1063054917f8ad9268897c1f872c8. Every linked cubin has 168 entry symbols; nvdisasm found exactly 252 LDTM instructions: one LDTM.STAT per 32x32b leaf and one t0_t15 base half plus one t16_t31 half at base+0x10 per 16x32bx2 leaf, with the reduction encoded as .MIN/.MAX (126 each), .S32 (42), .F32 (168), ABS (84), and .NAN (84).
